title: Rusty Arsenal
description: Rusty Arsenal is a small addon for Forge 1.20.1 that adds a collection of rough but effective weapons and tools to the game
body:
**Rusty Arsenal** is a small addon for Forge 1.20.1 that adds a collection of rough but effective weapons and tools to the game.

**Mod contents:**

**6 unique items:**

_Glass Dagger_

![Craft1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e008828cda21119aa25e3d6f0090d65d2c8338fe.png)

_Broken Bottle_

![Craft2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b8b8729a7fa8b77eb58f83318c16a86745287366.png)

_Butcher's Cleaver_

![Craft3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d12d907d93dbcef00122597ad56589297d76c78d.png)

_Garden Shears_

![Craft4](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f07d27625b05e9b9e21461f18940d25a4a2596b0_0.webp)

_Judge's Hammer_

![Craft5](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5a947881df90eaa6f926a7395d7905776aacf577.png)

_shepherds Staff_

![Craft6](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0a29e9016114f9a4ad7a2a13073a622a2b358795.png)

**1 new biome** (currently contains no unique content)

**📌 Important: In the current version, the biome exists as a foundation for future updates. If the mod receives support and attention from players, future updates will add unique enemies, new items, and full biome development.**

_Note: This is my first ever mod._
